title: Revenue shows a negative figure when credits exceed sales
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as a user whose role has the Reports permission (for example Admin).
  2. You use a desktop browser window at least 1024 pixels wide (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  3. You are in a location (workplace) where no invoice has been created today.
  4. That location has an invoice from an earlier day with a part on it (e.g. a part with Sell Price $160.00).

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 3: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. On the QA site try Staging Heavy Duty - 9919. Check: Reports > Sales > Date: pick a custom range of today only in the calendar (click today twice, then Apply): the total reads $0.00. If not, try the other locations in the list. If no location in the list passes this check, mark the case Blocked and write in the result comment that no location has this data.
  • For 4: Customers > a customer > Invoices tab (turn Open only off) lists their invoices; open one dated before today whose work order's Parts tab shows a part, and find it on the work order's Finance tab.
custom_steps:
1. On that earlier invoice: Finance tab > the invoice's three-dot menu > Issue Credit.
  2. Pick the part to return (e.g. the $160.00 part), choose Store Credit and submit.
  3. Click Dashboard in the top menu.
  4. On the Revenue tile, open the range pill, pick today only in the calendar (click today twice) and click Apply.
  5. Read the headline (the large figure) on the Revenue tile.
  6. Click the arrow icon beside "Revenue" and read the Sales report total for the same range.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Revenue headline shows the true negative figure, e.g. "-$160.00" (sales today $0.00 minus credits today $160.00). It does not show $0.00.
  • The Sales report total for today reads the same negative figure, to the cent.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9575 (Story 3, Measure Formulas and Report Parity); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 3.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-E1: “The Revenue figure can be negative when credit memos in the range exceed sales; the dashboard shows the true negative figure rather than flooring it at zero.”
